title: Ameresco Secures $42 Million Contract to Modernize Electric and Water Metering Infrastructure for the City of Columbia, MO
summary: Ameresco collaborates with Columbia, Missouri, on a new AMI project to modernize water and electric meters citywide, improving efficiency and data transparency.
body_markdown:
## *Water and electric meter modernization will strengthen reliability, transparency, and long-term service for Missouri residents*


**FRAMINGHAM, MA, and COLUMBIA, MO, October, 8 2026, 2026** –[Ameresco, Inc.](https://www.ameresco.com/) , (NYSE: AMRC), a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions to create reliable power and modernize infrastructure, today announced that the City of Columbia, Missouri, has selected Ameresco to implement a citywide Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) project. The project is expected to modernize the City’s utility infrastructure while delivering substantial benefits in operational efficiency, customer service, and data transparency.


The project, valued at $42M, will replace approximately 53,992 electric meters and 52,747 water meters across Columbia, along with the installation of a new AMI network, meter data management software, and integration with the City’s existing billing and customer portal systems. The upgrade will replace metering infrastructure that has exceeded its useful life, giving the City a connected system built for long-term operational reliability, with improved metering accuracy expected to generate operational savings and increased revenue over time.


The upgrade is expected to deliver a range of additional benefits for both residents and City operations, including:


- Transparent, near real-time access to electric and water usage data
- Faster outage and leak detection
- More accurate and equitable billing
- Reduced field service and meter reading costs
- Improved data to support future infrastructure planning


“Modernizing our metering infrastructure gives the City better visibility into how our systems are performing and allows us to respond more quickly to service needs,” said Gwen Corches, Assistant Director, Electric Utility for the City of Columbia. “With more accurate, timely data, we can improve the resident experience today while giving our teams the information they need to plan for the community’s future.”


For both Ameresco and Columbia, the project represents a long-term investment in modernizing the critical public infrastructure residents depend on for accurate, reliable service. The AMI project builds on an existing collaboration between Ameresco and the City, which also includes a separate project to modernize 22-year-old HVAC systems and interior lighting at the historic Armory Sports and Recreation Center (Armory), originally built in 1939 and last remodeled in 2000. ****


“This project reflects Columbia’s continued commitment to investing in the infrastructure that supports its community,” said Louis Maltezos, Co-President of Ameresco. “Modernizing its metering infrastructure is an important step in strengthening the systems residents depend on every day, while creating a foundation for future needs. We’re proud to continue supporting the City as it invests in both its future and its history.”


To learn more about Ameresco’s AMI and Automatic Meter Reading (AMR) solutions, visit[https://www.ameresco.com/advanced-metering-infrastucture/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameresco.com%2Fadvanced-metering-infrastucture%2F&esheet=54558327&newsitemid=20260623422079&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameresco.com%2Fadvanced-metering-infrastucture%2F&index=2&md5=98cc87a1ca0c6e9aab731b9bdb20d34e) .


**About Ameresco, Inc.**


Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC) is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions to create reliable power and modernize infrastructure. The company’s *Power Infrastructure* business integrates energy resources across behind-the-meter and utility-scale systems. Its *Buildings & Public Infrastructure* business modernizes the built environment with smart, connected solutions that optimize performance and enhance resilience. Ameresco is a trusted full lifecycle partner, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting over 5 GW of energy resources since its founding in 2000. Headquartered in Massachusetts, Ameresco serves public and private sector customers across North America and Europe. What Advanced Metering Infrastructure project did Ameresco announce for the City of Columbia, Missouri?


Ameresco announced a $42 million Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) project for the City of Columbia, Missouri, that will replace approximately 53,992 electric meters and 52,747 water meters, deploy a new AMI network, install meter data management software, and integrate the system with existing billing and customer portal platforms to modernize utility infrastructure.


How will the City of Columbia, Missouri benefit from Ameresco’s Advanced Metering Infrastructure project?


Ameresco’s AMI project will help the City of Columbia replace utility infrastructure that has exceeded its useful life while improving operational efficiency, strengthening long-term reliability, increasing metering accuracy, and providing better data to support future infrastructure planning.


How will Columbia utility customers benefit from Ameresco’s electric and water meter modernization project?


Ameresco’s AMI project will provide Columbia utility customers with near real-time access to electric and water usage data while supporting faster outage and leak detection, more accurate and equitable billing, and greater transparency into utility service and consumption.


What Advanced Metering Infrastructure technologies is Ameresco deploying in Columbia, Missouri?


Ameresco is deploying approximately 53,992 electric meters, 52,747 water meters, a new Advanced Metering Infrastructure network, meter data management software, and integrations with the City of Columbia’s existing billing and customer portal systems to create a connected utility platform.


What is Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) and how does it improve utility operations?


Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) is a utility technology system that enables automated meter data collection and communication. Ameresco’s AMI solution provides improved visibility into electric and water usage, supports greater metering accuracy, and gives customers access to near real-time consumption data.


How will Ameresco’s AMI project help the City of Columbia detect water leaks and utility service issues?


Ameresco’s AMI project will provide more timely utility data that supports faster leak detection and outage identification across Columbia’s water and electric systems. Improved visibility into system performance will help the City respond more quickly to service needs.


How does Ameresco’s Advanced Metering Infrastructure project support operational efficiency in Columbia, Missouri?


Ameresco’s AMI project supports operational efficiency by reducing field service and meter reading costs while improving metering accuracy and data visibility. These improvements are expected to generate operational savings and support more informed infrastructure planning over time.


Why is Ameresco’s utility infrastructure modernization project important for Columbia, Missouri?


Ameresco’s utility infrastructure modernization project is important for Columbia because it replaces aging metering infrastructure with a connected system designed for long-term operational reliability, improved customer service, greater transparency, and stronger utility system performance.
